steps.content: The Yin-Yang fish talisman guides your steps until you stand before a mass of thick, churning fog. It surges and rolls like a living thing, yet the air around you is perfectly still. Not a whisper of wind reaches your ears.
Lichen stares into that ominous gray, her chest rising and falling in shallow, careful breaths. Her fingers tighten around the jade pendant until her knuckles blanch.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: This is the place. No doubt about it.

The moment she steels her will, the gray-white fog holds still, just for an instant. Then it begins to turn, spiraling inward like a slow, silent whirlpool. At its heart, a figure takes shape: a faded robe, indistinct at first, then slowly gathering into form.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: ...Shifu. I finally found you.
Her tone is certain as she slowly paces forward, one deliberate step.
Wait! That's—
But the figure that forms before you is not the elderly Daoist Lichen described. It is her. The mask, the one you know too well.
Yet she appears more real now than she ever was in the Void of Yin. Every thread of her robe stands out with impossible clarity. Light plays across her mask's smooth surface.
—You are not <color=#fb9259>seeing</color> her. She <color=#fb9259>exists</color> within your consciousness.
In an instant, the silence shatters into a thousand whispering fragments: broken prayers tumbling from unseen lips, each one burning with fevered devotion.

The words find your ears. They burrow, insects with hard shells and tiny, jointed limbs that scrape against tender flesh as they force their way deeper. Into your skull. Into your mind. And there, in the fertile dark, they birth new things—countless eggs that pulse and squirm, already hatching.

steps.speaker: Eldritch Voice
steps.content: Incense unending... the divine gaze falls...

Around the phantom, hazy figures materialize from the gloom. They throw themselves to the ground, foreheads pressing into dust, worshipping. And as they bow their heads, they hurl clots of dark, viscous matter toward the one who stands at the center.

steps.speaker: Eldritch Voice
steps.content: Beseeching the sacred writ... pardon from the turning wheel...
Pale blue flames ignite at her feet, crackling softly at first, then building into a fierce, hungry roar.

She does not move. Her mask shows nothing: no joy, no sorrow, no pain. The fire climbs. Her robes char and curl, falling away to reveal pale flesh beneath. In the heat, skin begins to peel from her ankles, slowly, strip by strip.
Then, a myriad voices rise as one—

steps.speaker: Eldritch Voice
steps.content: Flesh given to the Dao... shelter your servants... The underworld awaits... all shall be rendered...

steps.speaker: Eldritch Voice
steps.content: All... shall be rendered...!
No... No... Don't go... That's not...!
You open your mouth, but all sound is swallowed by an overwhelming hollowness.
The phantom lifts her masked face, just slightly.
Around her, the devotees freeze. A tableau of worship arrested mid-prayer. Then, in a motion too synchronized, their faces turn to find you.
[Transition 1s]
<color=#dg1f1f>But they have no faces.</color>

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: ...Heh, these are indeed the arts of the Tianyi Sect. Step back, young friend.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Let me handle this.
